scanNote: 20-mashqning oxirgi bo'shlig'i (Sally: She's ... old) va 21-mashqdagi jadval bo'shliqlari kassetada aniqlanadi. Har biriga sabab va tabiiy fakt asosidagi javob berilgan; 20-mashqning yosh javobi audio talab qiladi.

sections.title: Everyday English — asking about pets
sections.titleUz: Kundalik ingliz tili — uy hayvonlari haqida so'rash

exercises.instructionEn: Rose has got two pet rabbits and her friend Ron is asking her questions about them. Match Ron's questions to Rose's answers, then act out the dialogue.
exercises.instructionUz: Rouzning ikkita uy quyoni bor, do'sti Ron esa ular haqida savol berayapti. Ronning savollarini Rouzning javoblariga moslang, so'ng dialogni sahnalashtiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOL SO'ZLARI VA JAVOB TURLARI:
  What are their names?      → nomlar
  How old are they?          → yosh
  What do they eat?          → ovqat
  When do you feed them?     → vaqt
  Where do they live?        → joy
  How often do you clean it? → NECHA MARTA (chastota)

DIQQAT — 'HOW OFTEN':
  'How often ...?' = qanchalik tez-tez? necha marta?
  Javob: once a week, twice a week, two or three times a week,
         every morning, every day

KITOBDA BERILGAN: 1 → B.

QUYONLARNING NOMI: Hansel va Gretel — mashhur nemis ertagidagi
aka-singilning ismlari.

pairs.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN javob: B. Ism so'ralgan → ism aytilgan.
Ikkita quyon → 'their' (ularning), 'nameS' (ko'plik).

Yosh so'ralgan. 'One year old' — bir yosh (yil BIRLIKDA, chunki bitta).
Ikki yosh bo'lsa: 'Two yearS old'.

Ovqat so'ralgan. Quyon sabzavot yeydi.
'lettuce' = salat bargi (sanalmaydi), 'carrots' = sabzilar.

Joy so'ralgan ('Where'). 'a cage' = qafas.
Javob joy predlogi IN bilan boshlanadi.

pairs.left: 6  How often do you clean it?
pairs.right: E  Two or three times a week.
pairs.whyUz:
Chastota so'ralgan ('How often').
'... times A week' — haftasiga ... marta ('a' = har).
DIQQAT: 'it' = qafas (5-javobdagi 'a big cage').

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and tick. Listen again and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va belgilang. Yana tinglab, takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI UNLI TOVUSH:

  /e/  — QISQA 'e'. O'zbekcha 'e' ga o'xshaydi.
         Og'iz kam ochiladi, tovush qisqa.
         Yozilishi: e, ea
         Misollar: bed, ten, head, red, pen

  /ɜː/ — UZUN, chuqur tovush. O'zbekchada YO'Q.
         'yo' va 'o' orasidagi, lablar cho'zilmaydi.
         Yozilishi: ir, er, ur, ear, or (w dan keyin)
         Misollar: bird, herd, turn, girl, work, learn

QANDAY FARQLASH:
  Undoshdan keyin R kelsa → ko'pincha /ɜː/
  R bo'lmasa → /e/

  bed  — R yo'q  → /e/
  bird — 'ir'    → /ɜː/
  herd — 'er'    → /ɜː/
  head — R yo'q  → /e/
  ten  — R yo'q  → /e/
  turn — 'ur'    → /ɜː/

items.whyUz: bird /bɜːd/ — 'ir' birikmasi uzun chuqur tovush beradi.
head /hed/ — 'ea' bu yerda qisqa 'e' beradi. 'herd' dan farqi shu.
turn /tɜːn/ — 'ur' birikmasi uzun chuqur tovush beradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogue, then listen and fill in the missing words. Close your books and, in pairs, act out the dialogue.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni o'qing, so'ng tinglab, tushib qolgan so'zlarni qo'ying. Kitobni yopib, juftlikda dialogni sahnalashtiring.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Oxirgi bo'shliqdagi YOSH faqat kassetada aytiladi. Qolgan to'rt bo'shliq dialog mantig'idan aniq topiladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
UY HAYVONI HAQIDA SO'RASHNING 4 SAVOLI:
  1) What's your dog's name?      — ismi
  2) What kind of dog is it?      — zoti
  3) Is it a male or a female?    — jinsi
  4) How old is she/he?           — yoshi

DIQQAT — MANTIQIY ZANJIR:
  'Is it a male or a female?' savoliga javobdan keyin
  Tom 'How old is SHE?' deydi → demak javob FEMALE bo'lgan.

LUG'AT:
  a collie — kolli (Shotlandiya cho'pon iti zoti)
  a male   — erkak (hayvonda)
  a female — urg'ochi (hayvonda)
  a kind of ... = ... turi, zoti

lines.whyUz:
'What's your dog's name?' = What IS ... .
DIQQAT: ikkita 's bor — biri qisqartma (What's), biri egalik (dog's).

'What kind of ...?' = qanday turdagi? qaysi zot?
'What type of ...?' ham to'g'ri, lekin kitob 'kind' beradi.

lines.textEn: Is it a male or a female?

lines.whyUz:
Keyingi savolda 'How old is SHE?' deyilgan → demak it URG'OCHI.
'a female' = urg'ochi.
'How old is she?' = U necha yoshda? Javob yosh bilan beriladi.

AUDIO: aniq yosh kassetada. Qolip: 'She's + son + yearS + old'.
DIQQAT: bir yoshdan katta bo'lsa 'yearS' (ko'plik):
  She's TWO YEARS old.  (1 yosh bo'lsa: She's ONE YEAR old.)

exercises.instructionEn: Read the table, then listen and fill in the gaps. Finally, look at your notes and talk about each animal.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalni o'qing, so'ng tinglab bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring. Nihoyat, yozuvlaringizga qarab har bir hayvon haqida gapiring.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Olti bo'shliqning hammasi kassetada aytiladi. Quyidagi javoblar tabiiy faktlarga va jadvaldagi kontekstga asoslangan — har biriga sabab keltirilgan.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL (bo'shliqlar bilan):

                  LIONS                    CHIMPANZEES
  kind of animal: mammals                  mammals
  they can:       hunt at night            learn very easily
  they've got:    light brown fur          .......... or brown fur
                  and a long ..........    and very long arms
                  (male lions have got
                   a big mane)
  they live:      on the hot plains         in African ..........
                  of ..........
  they eat:       zebras and other          fruit and vegetables
                  animals                   (favourite food — bananas)
  they live for:  about 12 to ......... years   about ......... to 45 years

Bu jadval yozma ish (Writing) uchun REJA bo'lib xizmat qiladi.

items.textEn: LIONS — they've got: light brown fur and a long ............
items.hintUz: Sherning orqasidagi uzun qism (uchida tuk bor)
items.whyUz: Sherning uzun dumi bor, uchida qora tuk. 40–41-betdagi 'a tail' so'zi.

items.textEn: CHIMPANZEES — they've got: ............ or brown fur and very long arms
items.hintUz: Rasmda shimpanzening juni asosan shu rangda
items.whyUz:
Shimpanzening juni qora yoki jigarrang. Rasmda qora ko'rinadi.
44-betdagi ranglar ro'yxatidan.

items.textEn: LIONS — they live: on the hot plains of ............
items.whyUz:
Sher Afrika savannasida yashaydi. 43-betdagi fil ham 'on the plains in Africa'.
'hot plains' = issiq tekisliklar.

Shimpanze Afrika o'rmonlarida yashaydi — uzun qo'llari bilan daraxtga chiqadi.
'a forest' → ko'plikda 'forests'.

items.textEn: LIONS — they live for: about 12 to ............ years
items.whyUz:
Sher tabiatda taxminan 12–16 yil yashaydi.
Delfin 50, fil 60, koala 15 — sher esa 16.

items.textEn: CHIMPANZEES — they live for: about ............ to 45 years
items.whyUz: Shimpanze taxminan 40–45 yil yashaydi — odamga eng yaqin hayvon.

exercises.instructionEn: Finally, look at your notes and talk about each animal.
exercises.instructionUz: Nihoyat, yozuvlaringizga qarab har bir hayvon haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
Jadvaldagi har bir qatorni gapga aylantiring.
41-betdagi delfin-pingvin jadvali bilan bir xil usul.

example.uz: Ularning och jigarrang juni va uzun dumi bor.

example.uz: Ular zebra va boshqa hayvonlarni yeydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Your teacher has asked you to write two short texts (50-80 words each) about lions and chimpanzees. Use the information from Ex. 21 and the pictures from the Photo File section to write about these wild animals. Use the texts in Ex. 3 as models.
exercises.instructionUz: O'qituvchingiz sizdan sherlar va shimpanzelar haqida ikkita qisqa matn (har biri 50–80 so'z) yozishni so'radi. 21-mashqdagi ma'lumot va Photo File bo'limidagi rasmlardan foydalaning. 3-mashqdagi matnlarni namuna qilib oling.
exercises.explanationUz:
TALAB:
  • ikkita matn
  • har biri 50–80 so'z
  • namuna: 40-betdagi delfin va pingvin matnlari (3-mashq)
  • ma'lumot: 21-mashqdagi jadval

3-MASHQ MATNI QOLIPI (delfin matni tuzilishi):
  1-xatboshi: turi + tanasi + og'irligi
  2-xatboshi: xarakteri va qobiliyati
  3-xatboshi: qayerda yashaydi + nima yeydi + qancha yashaydi

Barcha gaplar KO'PLIKDA (Lions ... They ...).

structure.modelEn: Lions are mammals. They have babies and feed them on milk. They've got light brown fur and a long tail. Male lions have also got a big mane around their head. They weigh from 150 to 250 kilos.
structure.noteUz: 'a mane' = yol — 40-betda ham bor. 'around their head' = boshlari atrofida.

structure.modelEn: Lions are very strong animals. They can run very fast and they can hunt at night. They live in groups called prides.
structure.noteUz: 'hunt' = ov qilmoq. 'a pride' = sherlar guruhi (maxsus so'z).

structure.modelEn: Lions live on the hot plains of Africa. They eat zebras and other animals. They live for about 12 to 16 years.
Chimpanzees are mammals. They have babies and feed them on milk. They've got black or brown fur and very long arms. They weigh about 45 to 80 kilos.
Chimpanzees are very intelligent animals. They can learn very easily and they can use tools. They are friendly to people.
structure.noteUz:
'intelligent', 'easily', 'friendly to' — 40-betdagi delfin matnidan olingan so'zlar.
'a tool' = asbob.

structure.modelEn: Chimpanzees live in African forests. They live in big groups and they eat fruit and vegetables. Their favourite food is bananas. They live for about 40 to 45 years.

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
To'rtta ingliz maqoli — hammasi HAYVONLAR haqida.
Unit sarlavhasi ham shulardan biridan olingan.

items.en: Birds of a feather flock together.
items.uz:
So'zma-so'z: Bir xil patli qushlar birga to'planadi.

MA'NOSI: O'xshash odamlar bir-birini topadi va birga bo'ladi.

O'ZBEKCHA MUQOBILI: 'Qush qushi bilan, quloq quloq bilan.'

DIQQAT: 6-UNIT SARLAVHASI shu maqoldan olingan —
'Birds of a Feather...'

LUG'AT: to flock = to'planmoq, gala bo'lmoq

items.en: While the cat's away, the mice will play.
items.uz:
So'zma-so'z: Mushuk yo'q ekan, sichqonlar o'ynaydi.

MA'NOSI: Rahbar (yoki nazorat qiluvchi) yo'q bo'lganda,
odamlar o'zlari xohlagan ishni qiladi.

O'ZBEKCHA MUQOBILI: 'Mushuk yo'q uyda sichqon bayram qiladi.'

DIQQAT: 'mice' — 44-betdagi noto'g'ri ko'plik!
'while' = ...ekan, ...paytda

So'zma-so'z: Katta baliqlar kichik baliqlarni yeydi.

MA'NOSI: Kuchlilar zaiflar hisobiga yashaydi;
katta kompaniyalar kichiklarini yutib yuboradi.

DIQQAT: 'fish' — ko'plikda ham 'fish' (44-bet).
Shuning uchun fe'l ko'plikda: 'eat' ('eats' emas).

'little' = kichkina ('small' bilan bir xil)

So'zma-so'z: Qiziquvchanlik mushukni o'ldirdi.

MA'NOSI: Haddan tashqari qiziquvchanlik zarar keltiradi —
begona ishga burun tiqmaslik kerak.

O'ZBEKCHA MUQOBILI: 'Ko'p bilgan tez qariydi' yoki
'Har ishga burun tiqma.'

LUG'AT: curiosity /ˌkjʊəriˈɒsəti/ = qiziquvchanlik
        curious = qiziquvchan

wordFormation.introUz: 45-bet — chastota iboralari, jins so'zlari va talaffuz juftliklari.

groups.explanationUz: '... a week / a day' dagi 'a' — 'har' degani.
Umumiy so'zlar va ba'zi hayvonlarning maxsus nomlari.
'year' birlik yoki ko'plik bo'lishiga e'tibor bering.

patterns.formula: How often do you + fe'l? — ... times a week / every morning.
patterns.exampleEn: How often do you clean it? — Two or three times a week.
patterns.exampleUz: Uni qanchalik tez-tez tozalaysiz? — Haftada ikki-uch marta.
patterns.explanationUz: 'How often' — chastota savoli. Javobda 'a week' = haftasiga.

patterns.formula: What kind of + ot + is it? — It's a + tur.
patterns.exampleEn: What kind of dog is it? — It's a collie.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu qanday zotdagi it? — Bu kolli.
patterns.explanationUz: 'What kind of ...?' = qanday turdagi? qaysi zot?

patterns.formula: Is it a male or a female? — It's a male/female.
patterns.exampleEn: Is it a male or a female? — It's a female.
patterns.exampleUz: U erkakmi yoki urg'ochimi? — U urg'ochi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Tanlov savoli: A or B. Javobda faqat bittasi aytiladi.
Javobdan keyin olmosh o'zgaradi: female → SHE, male → HE.

patterns.exampleEn: She's two years old. He's one year old.
patterns.exampleUz: U ikki yoshda. U bir yoshda.
patterns.explanationUz: 1 yosh → year (birlik). 2 va undan katta → yearS.

patterns.formula: They live for about X to Y years.
patterns.exampleEn: Lions live for about 12 to 16 years.

vocabularyOnPage.en: two or three times a week
